family.name: RP2040-Decoder
family.comment: Open-source RP2040 based DCC decoder, Rust firmware (dcc-rp2040-rs)

variable.label: Start voltage (Vstart)
variable.tooltip: Back-EMF target at speed step 1, in raw 12-bit ADC counts (not multiplied by 16).

variable.label: Acceleration rate
variable.tooltip: Time per speed step while accelerating = CV3 x CV175 ms. 0 = no momentum.

variable.label: Deceleration rate
variable.tooltip: Time per speed step while decelerating = CV4 x CV175 ms. 0 = no momentum.

variable.label: Max voltage (Vhigh)
variable.tooltip: Back-EMF target at the top speed step = CV5 x 16 ADC counts (255 = full 12-bit range). Rewritten by a successful motor calibration run (CV176).

variable.label: Mid voltage (Vmid)
variable.tooltip: Back-EMF target at speed step 63 = CV6 x 16 ADC counts. Rescaled by a successful motor calibration run, keeping the CV6/CV5 ratio.

variable.label: Manufacturer ID
variable.tooltip: 13 = Public-domain and DIY. Writing 8 to CV8 resets all CVs to factory defaults.

variable.label: Motor PWM frequency (Hz)
variable.tooltip: Stored as (Hz - 10000) / 100. Takes effect after a power cycle.

variable.label: Motor PWM clock divider
variable.tooltip: Additional motor PWM clock divider. 0 is treated as 1. Takes effect after a power cycle.

variable.label: Speed step period (ms)
variable.tooltip: Base period of the acceleration/deceleration ramp; multiplies CV3 and CV4.

variable.label: Calibration control / status
variable.tooltip: Ops mode (on the main) only: writing 'Start calibration run' makes the loco run FORWARD at full speed for about 1.6 s, then it rewrites CV5/CV6 and reboots. The loco must be stopped; any throttle change aborts. Read on the programming track to see the result. Only 'Idle' (clears the status) and 'Start calibration run' can be written.

variable.label: Calibrated EMF max (ADC counts)
variable.tooltip: Back-EMF measured at 100% PWM by the last calibration run, after subtracting the ADC offset. Stored big-endian in CV177 (high) and CV178 (low).

variable.label: Calibration headroom (CV/255)
variable.tooltip: A calibration run sets CV5 = EMF max x CV179 / 255 / 16. Default 235 = 92%: the top speed step targets 92% of the speed reached at full power, leaving the controller reserve to hold speed under load. Lower = more reserve but lower top speed; 255 = no reserve. Only used when a calibration runs.

variable.label: Startup seed k_ff (CV/255)
variable.tooltip: Fraction of the startup drive level used to seed the PID when leaving startup mode = CV47 / 255.

variable.label: Ki (x10)
variable.tooltip: Integral gain = CV50 / 10. Default 25 = 2.5.

variable.label: Kd (x10000)
variable.tooltip: Derivative gain = CV51 / 10000. Default 50 = 0.005.

variable.label: Kp at standstill (x100)
variable.tooltip: Kp at the lowest setpoint = value / 100. Default 2000 = 20. Stored big-endian in CV54 (high) and CV55 (low).

variable.label: Kp at gain-range end (x100)
variable.tooltip: Kp at the point set by CV60 = value / 100. Default 250 = 2.5. Stored big-endian in CV56 (high) and CV57 (low).

variable.label: Kp at max speed (x100)
variable.tooltip: Kp at the highest setpoint = value / 100. Default 150 = 1.5. Stored big-endian in CV58 (high) and CV59 (low).

variable.label: Kp gain-range shift (CV/255)
variable.tooltip: Position of the Kp x1 point as a fraction of the setpoint range = CV60 / 255.

variable.label: Delay before measuring (us)
variable.tooltip: Time between cutting motor power and sampling back-EMF.

variable.label: Discard lowest samples
variable.tooltip: Number of smallest samples discarded as outliers. CV63 + CV64 must be less than CV61.

variable.label: Discard highest samples
variable.tooltip: Number of largest samples discarded as outliers. CV63 + CV64 must be less than CV61.

variable.label: ADC offset
variable.tooltip: Measured automatically at boot when 255. Write 255 to force a re-measurement on next power-up.

variable.label: GPIO0 uses PWM
variable.tooltip: GPIO0: CV115 bit 0. When off the output is plain on/off.

variable.tooltip: GPIO1: CV115 bit 1. When off the output is plain on/off.

variable.label: AUX3 uses PWM

variable.label: Slice 0 (GPIO0/GPIO1) wrap
variable.tooltip: Counter top value. PWM frequency = 125 MHz / (divider x (wrap + 1)). CV116/CV117.

variable.label: Slice 0 clock divider

variable.label: GPIO0 level
